about: Local service businesses (dentists, plumbers, salons, trainers, mechanics, real-estate agents, restaurants) upload a CSV of past customers, and Respark automatically runs a 5-message reactivation campaign over 30 days: 3 emails and 2 SMS.

steps.title: Sign up
steps.body: A local business creates an account.

steps.title: Upload past customers
steps.body: Drop in a CSV of customers who stopped coming.

steps.title: Campaign runs itself
steps.body: 5 messages over 30 days: 3 emails and 2 SMS, with unsubscribe links and tracking.

steps.title: You bill a retainer
steps.body: The operator charges clients a setup fee plus a monthly retainer.
